
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#12305c">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>إعدادية عانة للبنين</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Reem+Kufi:wght@500;700&family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f6f9;--surface:#fff;--ink:#14233b;--muted:#55627a;--navy:#12305c;--on-navy:#fff;--gold:#e3a72f;--green:#2c7a5a;--line:#d9dfe9;--head:#12305c;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#0e1522;--surface:#162033;--ink:#e8edf6;--muted:#9fadc4;--navy:#1c3d70;--line:#2a3650;--green:#4fb48a;--head:#e3a72f}}
html{scroll-padding-top:60px;scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Tajawal,Tahoma,sans-serif;line-height:1.8;font-size:17px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Reem Kufi',Tajawal,sans-serif;line-height:1.35;margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{background:var(--navy);color:var(--on-navy);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-block:8px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:'Reem Kufi',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;white-space:nowrap}
.lg{width:42px;height:42px;flex:none}
